independent_numerical_checks.formula: For df4 and a=abs(t), let r=sqrt(t^2+4), x=a/r and q=1-x=4/(r*(r+a)). The two-sided null tail is1-1.5*x+0.5*x^3 =0.5*q^2*(3-q). The q form avoids cancellation for large t. It gives p=1 at t=0 and p=.05 at the original2.7764451051977987 critical value.
independent_numerical_checks.independent_route: Also numerically integrated the df4 t density after t=2*tan(theta): two-sided tail is integral from atan(a/2) to pi/2 of1.5*cos(theta)^3 dtheta, using a separate composite Simpson calculation. This matched all supplied p values to better than1e-10 relative tolerance; no supplied audit or model function was executed.
independent_numerical_checks.estimator: For each named contrast, mean=fsum(deltas)/5, sampleSD=sqrt(sum((delta-mean)^2)/4), SE=SD/sqrt(5), t=mean/SE, df4, CI=mean plus/minus2.7764451051977987*SE. This uses five seed units rather than test examples as replications.

assumptions_and_independence.unit: Independent training-seed differences conditional on the same fixed dataset, feature pipeline, model protocol and frozen permutation rule
assumptions_and_independence.normality: Student-t calibration is exact for independent normal seed differences and approximate for approximately normal differences. The original plan states that assumption. With n=5, neither the data nor a normality test can certify the distribution shape or protect against rare heavy-tail behavior; do not treat tiny parametric p values as assumption-free certainty.
assumptions_and_independence.seed_independence: Distinct predeclared RNG seeds with separate fitted models and no outcome-based inclusion plausibly implement conventional conditional training-run independence. Distinct integers alone are not empirical proof of independence; shared datasets make these five training replications, not five datasets or five population samples.
assumptions_and_independence.endpoints: Within-seed utility and CE effects may be correlated. That does not invalidate paired seed analysis or the conjunctive intersection-union decision. Do not count the endpoints as extra independent replications.
assumptions_and_independence.scope: These intervals quantify training-seed variation for the fixed benchmark evaluation, not uncertainty over unseen benchmark datasets, document/entity populations, permutation distributions or hyperparameter searches.

multiplicity_judgment.logic: The original success decision requires both utility and CE gates. For H0: meanMacro<=0 OR meanCE<=0 against the conjunction meanMacro>0 AND meanCE>0, rejecting only when both component tests pass controls the intersection-union false-positive probability by the largest component level regardless of endpoint dependence. Two-sided95% lower-bound-positive rules are conservative directional component tests.
multiplicity_judgment.historical_handling: The old text does not name a multiplicity method, but it concretely freezes both gates and makes them conjunctive. Describing the implied IUT is an audit of the existing decision rule, not retroactively adding a correction. This justification applies only to the sole conjunctive claim, not unrestricted separate claims or a selected best endpoint.
multiplicity_judgment.sensitivity: Even a posthoc two-test Bonferroni sensitivity yields adjusted two-sided p8.228206328232867e-6 and3.6801754545306955e-5. It is not the historical plan and is not needed to rescue a failed original gate.
multiplicity_judgment.intervals: The two reported95% intervals are marginal endpoint intervals, not a guaranteed simultaneous95% confidence rectangle. Do not describe them as joint95% coverage.
multiplicity_judgment.other_searches: The IUT argument does not correct selective reporting across unrecorded idea searches, newly selected metrics or later tuned hypotheses. All frozen endpoints and all planned seeds must remain visible.
